observation.command:
cd /workspace
echo "=========== FINAL VERIFICATION ==========="
echo "--- ddev project state ---"
runuser -u dev -- ddev status 2>&1 | head -8
echo ""
echo "--- drush status (key lines) ---"
runuser -u dev -- ddev drush status 2>/dev/null | grep -E "Drupal version|Install profile|Default theme|Drupal bootstrap|Database|Site URI"
echo ""
echo "--- Enabled modules: $(runuser -u dev -- ddev drush config:get core.extension module -y 2>/dev/null | grep -c ':') ---"
echo "--- Content nodes: $(runuser -u dev -- ddev exec mysql -udb -pdb db -N -B -e 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM node' 2>/dev/null) ---"
echo ""
echo "--- HTTP homepage ---"
runuser -u dev -- ddev exec sh -c 'curl -s -o /dev/null -w "GET / -> HTTP %{http_code}\n" http://localhost/en; curl -s http://localhost/en | grep -oE "<title>[^<]*</title>" | head -1'
echo ""
echo "--- Working tree changes (installation fix) ---"
git status --short | grep -v "^?? example.org"
echo ""
echo "--- example.org (alternate documented method artifact) ---"
ls -d example.org && echo "composer deps installed: $([ -d example.org/web/core ] && echo yes)"
